items.question: What documents do I need for a personal loan?
items.answer: For salaried: PAN, Aadhaar, 3 months' salary slips, 6 months' bank statements. For self-employed: PAN, Aadhaar, ITR for 2 years, business proof. I'll guide you through everything.

items.question: Will my loan get approved if I have a low CIBIL score?
items.answer: Score above 700 gets the best rates. Between 650–700 we can still find solutions. Below 650, I can help you improve your score first. Call me for a free assessment.

items.question: What is the processing fee?
items.answer: Processing fees vary by bank (0.5%–2% of loan amount). For most of my partner banks, I can get fees waived or reduced. Mention you're coming through LoanBridge.
